description: The pie chart represents the distribution of emotion categories in the context of the paper “Evaluation of Speaker Anonymization on Emotional Speech,” and it contains six slices. The slices are labeled Frustration (light blue, about 25.1%), Neutral (purple/blue, about 23.1%), Anger (yellow, about 14.9%), Excitement (red, about 14.1%), Happiness (medium blue, about 8.1%), and Sadness (orange, percentage not visibly shown). Percentage values are printed inside most slices, and the category names are placed around the pie; there is no separate legend visible, and no slice appears exploded or otherwise visually emphasized. The slices do not appear to be arranged in a strictly descending or ascending order by size.
